name: Nicotinamide riboside

lead: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) is a form of vitamin B3 and a precursor to NAD+. It is sold as an oral supplement and has been tested in a number of human trials.
It is marketed for healthy aging and energy. Trials reliably show increased blood NAD+ levels, but benefits for muscle, metabolism or appearance have been modest or inconsistent.

paras: NR is phosphorylated by nicotinamide riboside kinases to NMN and then converted to NAD+, supporting sirtuin and DNA-repair enzyme activity.

Well tolerated in studies, with mild nausea, flushing or digestive effects at higher intakes. Long-term safety data are limited. It has GRAS status in the US and novel food approval in the EU; product quality varies.
